Welcome to %1$s! This replaces Android\'s screen rotation, so don\'t use the normal Android screen rotation settings.
There are two modes: %1$s and Locked. To see which one you\'re using, look at the notification in the notification drawer.
To change mode, press the button in the notification. You can also make a home screen shortcut to do this.
%1$s mode is the same as Android\'s screen rotation, but if %2$s thinks you\'re sideways, the screen will face sideways.
Your orientation (whether you\'re lying down or upright) is also tracked and shown in the notification.
To change your orientation, either use Locked mode or use the %1$s and %2$s notification buttons.
%1$s might not work with apps that control the screen orientation. When this happens, the notification icon will show your orientation.
To prevent the screen orientation being stuck when you uninstall, use the \"%1$s\" menu item on %2$s\'s main screen.
